title: Suppressed childhood memories resurface as PTSD flashbacks

tellings.quote: Uh, and getting into like late 2022, early 2023, um, just with some triggering things in normal life, I began to unravel, for lack of a better word, um, and unravel in a sensation that brought back, uh, what I could only describe as childhood memories that I had not previously recollected.
you wake up in a matter of two months and remember an entire childhood that you once forgotten.
tellings.difference: Puts the recovery at about two months in 2023 and calls it a crisis.
tellings.link_reason: Jordan's own account of childhood memories resurfacing around 2023, the same as the jordan-jose testimony.

as_told.title: Recovered childhood memories and crisis in 2023

plain: Jordan Jose, who says he was taken into a secret UFO programme as a child, tells Michels that in late 2022 and early 2023 everyday triggers made him "unravel" and brought back childhood memories he had never recalled, arriving like trauma flashbacks. He describes it as a crisis in which, within about two months, he would "wake up" and "remember an entire childhood" he had forgotten. He offers it as the way his account of the programme came back to him.
